### 🏹 Bow
- New weapon: a draw bow — hold fire to pull the string, release and a real arrow flies off in an arc
- Draw strength sets the arrow's speed, range and damage: a full draw (~1.1 s) drops a player in two body hits, a snap shot flies slow, loops down and barely stings
- Aiming zooms in slightly along the shaft; the next arrow is nocked automatically, so there is no reloading
- New "arrows" ammo — cheap and common; the bow shows up in the shop and in loot

### 🛸 Landed flying saucer
- A new landmark for map authors: a 9 m saucer standing on three legs, with a glass canopy, a ring of chasing lights in the rim, a breathing belly emitter and motes of light drifting up off the hull
- It has a voice — a soft, otherworldly chime every ~20 seconds, a hint on the wind from across the map and a real presence once you walk up to it

### 🧟 Horde waves
- Later waves now hold a growing number of zombies on you at once instead of trickling them in — a killed zombie is replaced until the wave's budget runs out
- The pressure also scales with how many players are in the room, and zombies arrive in a wave faster
- Zombies shoved around in a crowd no longer end up stuck inside walls, where they used to freeze up and disappear

### 🌍 Czech and English
- The whole game and the site are now fully bilingual — Czech and English
- The language is picked automatically from your system the first time and can be switched in the settings

### 🌐 Play in the browser
- The game can now be launched straight in a browser with no install — the "Play in browser" button on the site
- Fullscreen works in the browser version too
- Esc opens the pause menu in the browser as well; resume with a click (the Resume button or outside the menu), which is how the browser hands mouse-look back

### 🌫️ Fog at the map edge
- Map authors can surround the arena with fog that hides the emptiness past the map boundary and matches the color of the time of day
- The fogged area's size and how sharply it closes in are both set in the map settings

### 🪖 Military props
- New props: anti-tank hedgehog, barbed wire, field howitzer, towed rocket launcher, warning sign, a pyramid of artillery shells, a jerrycan rack and a rubble pile
- Barbed wire is not a solid obstacle — you can walk through it, but it slows you down and starts cutting the moment you step in
- The bus has a new look: a classic American school bus

### 🧱 Structures
- Walls with windows are now a single piece, so no visible seams show up on them

### 🏃 Movement
- You now slide along diagonally rotated walls instead of getting stuck in place

### ⚙️ Settings
- Redesigned settings menu — clear labeled rows instead of long buttons
- Sound volume is now set with a slider instead of just on/off

### 🔫 Weapons
- The sawed-off shotgun was removed from the game
